texts: mixed: the dating, the emergence out of the Cove's water and the because-link back to the burning are all carried, but the parse also records the burning as having CAUSED the lantern to be dim (a Result link), where your sentence only says it was dim as it burned — the instruction set says to drop that link whenever caused-vs-concurrent is unclear. Make the concurrency explicit: "On day 120 of Year 1, a wraith emerged from the water of the Sunken Cove, because the Stilllight Lantern had been dim while it burned on the night of day 111." Separate note you cannot fix by rewording: "day 120 of Year 1" lands as a bare day term that the instruction set defines as a day-of-month, so your day-of-year dating is recorded only loosely.
good. the only new content is the nine-day gap, and that is exactly what the parse adds — a measured ordering between the same burning and emergence already introduced, with nothing restated.

mixed: the seeing, Marra as the one who sees, the wraith, her station and its position near the Cove Stair are all covered, but the adverbial "first" is dropped with no atom at all, so the fact that she saw it before anyone else is lost. The instruction set does have a rank form for a predicative "first", so move the word into that shape: "From her station near the Cove Stair, Marra Tallowhand was the first to see the wraith."
good. a walking event with Marra as its agent and the Stilllight Lantern as its goal, on the same Lantern symbol used throughout the passage.

good. the position is recorded as a tense-wrapped locative atom with "already" on an opaque tag over it; that tag on a position clause is an improvisation the instruction set does not define, but it was judged acceptable rather than a defect and nothing is lost.
good. "was lit" is read as an agentless passive — a lighting event with the Lantern as the thing lit — which is the shape the instruction set prescribes for "Dinner was cooked."
good. "ground" is lemmatised to grind, the bare-plural "feathers" becomes a group witness, and Bevin is its agent with the feathers as what the grinding changes.

good. the definite "the ground feathers" reuses the group from the previous sentence rather than minting new ones, and "around the Stilllight Lantern" is kept on the scattering as a surface-preposition oblique instead of being flattened into a plain location.
good. the feathers are the agent, the Lantern is what gets warded, "against the wraith" stays on the warding event, and the wraith is the same one that emerged in the first sentence.

bad: the restatement mints a SECOND warding event instead of reusing the one the previous sentence introduced, so the knowledge base records two wardings where your text states one. The previous sentence already asserts the warding, so either drop this sentence, or state the resulting condition with a state word rather than repeating the verb: "The Stilllight Lantern was safe from the wraith."
good. the turning is recorded with the Lantern as the source the wraith turned from, which carries the "away from" direction compositionally.

good. the denial is one strength-0 bundle over the whole draining (event class, wraith as agent, Lantern as what would be drained, past tense) — the instruction set's form for a negated event — with the Lantern's own typing left standing outside it.
